say:1:1341126001:1.text: Once again, I'd like to express my gratitude for your generosity. The blue spiritroot plays a crucial role in my painting.
say:1:1341126001:1.source_cn: 请允许我再次多谢各位的馈赠。那株冰蓝灵蔓根对我的画来说...

choice_prompt:2:1341126001.text: Once again, I'd like to express my gratitude for your generosity. The blue spiritroot plays a crucial role in my painting.
choice_prompt:2:1341126001.source_cn: 请允许我再次多谢各位的馈赠。那株冰蓝灵蔓根对我的画来说意义重大。

say:3:1341126002:1.text: I'm truly grateful, as this painting holds great significance.
say:3:1341126002:1.source_cn: 这不是客气，是真心的感谢。这幅画很重要。

say:4:1341126003:1.text: I painted many pieces during my lifetime, but it's the only one that remains.
say:4:1341126003:1.source_cn: 我生前画过许多幅画，但我所说的这幅画，是我生前所有画作...

say:6:1341126004:1.text: The only one that remains? What happened to the rest?
say:6:1341126004:1.source_cn: 唯一留下来的？那其他的画都去哪里了？

say:7:1341126005:1.text: After my passing, a few of my works were purchased by other nobles—after all, I was considered an artist back then. Sadly, most of them couldn't withstand the test of time.
say:7:1341126005:1.source_cn: 我死之后，有少部分画作被别的贵族买回去收藏，毕竟我过去...

say:8:1341126006:1.text: Did you use magic to preserve this painting?
say:8:1341126006:1.source_cn: 这幅画能够保留下来，是因为你用魔法了吗？

say:9:1341126007:1.text: Nope. I simply restore it every ten years, touching up the faded colors and replacing the frame.
say:9:1341126007:1.source_cn: 不，我没有用魔法附灵，而是每隔十年进行一次修复，填上褪...

say:11:1341126008:1.text: The most striking blue in the painting can only be created by layering the powders of lapis lazuli and blue spiritroot.
say:11:1341126008:1.source_cn: 而那幅画里最漂亮的蓝色，需要用青金石粉末和冰蓝灵蔓根粉...

say:12:1341126009:1.text: Over the years, blue spiritroots have become scarcer. So, it's no exaggeration to say your gift means a lot to me.
say:12:1341126009:1.source_cn: 这些年来，冰蓝灵蔓根越来越难找了，即便是我也得花费很大...

choice_prompt:13:1341126009.text: Over the years, blue spiritroots have become scarcer. So, it's no exaggeration to say your gift means a lot to me.
choice_prompt:13:1341126009.source_cn: 这些年来，冰蓝灵蔓根越来越难找了，即便是我也得花费很大的心力。所以你瞧，我并没有夸大其词，你们的礼物真的很重要。

say:14:1341126010:1.text: Some prefer to keep their first work, as it symbolizes the beginning, while others keep their best as a reminder of their prime. For me, I chose one that represents the end—my last painting, my portrait.
say:14:1341126010:1.source_cn: 有些人喜欢留着第一份作品，因为它代表着开始；有些人则喜...

say:15:1341126011:1.text: My parents used to gaze at it, mourning me in tears every day, so one day, I secretly took it away.
say:15:1341126011:1.source_cn: 我的父母曾对着它日夜哭泣哀悼，所以后来我悄悄拿走了它。

say:16:1341126012:1.text: Then, they eventually came to understand that death is the end and an inevitable part of life, and they slowly stopped grieving over my passing.
say:16:1341126012:1.source_cn: 那之后，他们终于意识到死亡就是终结，是生命的必经之路。...

say:17:1341126013:1.text: I'll keep it until the day of my ultimate death arrives.
say:17:1341126013:1.source_cn: 所以……我会一直留着它，直到我自己彻底地、真正地死亡那天。

choice:13:0:1.text: That painting must hold a special meaning for you.
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 那幅画对你来说一定很有意义
choice:13:0:1.male: That painting must hold a special meaning for you.
choice:13:0:1.female: That painting must hold a special meaning for you.

choice:13:1:2.text: Why do you keep that painting?
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 为什么你要保留着那幅画？
choice:13:1:2.male: Why do you keep that painting?
choice:13:1:2.female: Why do you keep that painting?
